in_sanskrit.name: तेजनारायण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tej (बल्वान्) meaning power or strength, and Nara (मनुष्य) meaning man, and Rāyaṇ (राज्य) meaning kingdom or rule. So Tejnarayan means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who rules over wisdom and wealth.

in_hindi.name: तेजनारायण
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tej (शक्ति) meaning power or strength, and Nara (मनुष्य) meaning man, and Rāyaṇ (राज्य) meaning kingdom or rule. So Tejnarayan in Hindi means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who is full of power and is worthy of worship.

in_tamil.name: தேஜ்னாராயண்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Tej (விஜயம்) meaning power or strength, and Nārāyaṇ (அருள்வான்) meaning the one who is present with us in the form of God Vishnu. So Tejnarayan in Tamil means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who is always present with us in the form of God Vishnu.

in_telugu.name: తెజ్ఞానారాయణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Tej (శక్తి) meaning power or strength, and Nārāyaṇ (దేశియదేశ) meaning the king of kings or the one who is the god of gods. So Tejnarayan in Telugu means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who is the king of kings or the one who is the god of gods.

in_marathi.name: Tejnarayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power and Tej, meaning radiance, brilliance or splendor
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tejnarayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tej refers to radiance, brilliance or splendor, while Narayan is the name of Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism. The name Tejnarayan thus signifies the deity of power and radiance, and is a powerful and auspicious name for a boy.

in_bengali.name: Tejnarayan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Power and Tej, meaning radiance, brilliance or splendor
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tejnarayan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Tej refers to radiance, brilliance or splendor, while Narayan is the name of Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism. The name Tejnarayan thus signifies the deity of power and radiance, and is a powerful and auspicious name for a boy.
